fields.description: Save header magic word 0. Compared against ROM constants in FUN_08028eac; mismatch triggers full save re-init.
fields.evidence: FUN_08028eac reads EEPROM block 0 via FUN_0802fde4(0) and compares word 0 to header constant derived from DAT_08028fa8 (expected 0x0020, matches logical byte 0..1).
fields.name: header_magic_w0

fields.description: Save header magic word 1 (expected 0x0038).
fields.evidence: FUN_08028eac compares EEPROM block 0 word 1 to header constant (expected 0x0038, matches logical bytes 2..3).
fields.name: header_magic_w1

fields.description: Save header magic word 2 (expected 0x0030).
fields.evidence: FUN_08028eac compares EEPROM block 0 word 2 to header constant (expected 0x0030, matches logical bytes 4..5).
fields.name: header_magic_w2

fields.description: Save header magic word 3 (expected 0x0033).
fields.evidence: FUN_08028eac compares EEPROM block 0 word 3 to header constant (expected 0x0033, matches logical bytes 6..7).
fields.name: header_magic_w3

fields.description: Audio option A (baseline 7). Loaded from EEPROM block 1 word 0 by FUN_08029050; saved by FUN_08028fd8; fed into audio hardware init via FUN_0802fa00/FUN_0802f4cc/FUN_080011f8 path.
fields.evidence: FUN_08029050 loads EEPROM block 1 word 0 into option RAM; FUN_08028fd8 persists option RAM to block 1 word 0; value flows to FUN_0802fa00/FUN_0802f4cc/FUN_080011f8 audio-apply sequence (boot and options-menu apply paths).
fields.name: audio_option_a

fields.description: Audio option B (baseline 10). Loaded from EEPROM block 1 word 1 by FUN_08029050; saved by FUN_08028fd8; fed into audio hardware init via FUN_0802fa00/FUN_0802f4cc/FUN_080010c4 path.
fields.evidence: FUN_08029050 loads EEPROM block 1 word 1 into option RAM; FUN_08028fd8 persists option RAM to block 1 word 1; value flows to FUN_0802fa00/FUN_0802f4cc/FUN_080010c4 audio-apply sequence (boot and options-menu apply paths).
fields.name: audio_option_b

fields.description: Reserved option words (zero in baseline and after factory init).
fields.evidence: FUN_08028eac factory-init path writes EEPROM block 1 as [7,10,0,0]; FUN_08029050/FUN_08028fd8 move 4 words but only words 0..1 feed the audio-apply path.
fields.name: options_reserved

fields.description: Career file 1 rider initials, char 0 (baseline 'A'). Nonzero byte 0 marks the file present in FUN_08028dd0.
fields.evidence: FUN_0802897c loads EEPROM block 2 and stores block byte 0 (logical offset 16) as name char 0; FUN_08028494 stores name char 0 back to block 2 byte 0; FUN_08028dd0 treats block byte 0 != 0 as file-present.
fields.name: file1_name_c0

fields.description: Career file 1 rider initials, char 1 (baseline 'A').
fields.evidence: FUN_0802897c loads EEPROM block 2 byte 2 (logical offset 18) as name char 1; FUN_08028494 stores it back to the same byte.
fields.name: file1_name_c1

fields.description: Career file 1 rider initials, char 2 (baseline 'A').
fields.evidence: FUN_0802897c loads EEPROM block 2 byte 4 (logical offset 20) as name char 2; FUN_08028494 stores it back to the same byte.
fields.name: file1_name_c2

fields.description: Career file 1 bit-packed progress data, 8 EEPROM blocks (3..10). Unpacked bit-by-bit via FUN_0802845c in FUN_0802897c and repacked via FUN_08028408 in FUN_08028494.
fields.evidence: FUN_0802897c loops FUN_0802fde4 over blocks base+1..base+8 and unpacks every bit with FUN_0802845c; FUN_08028494 mirrors this with FUN_08028408/FUN_0802fe9c over the same blocks.
fields.name: file1_progress_bits

fields.description: Career file 1 per-rider rating block (EEPROM block 11). Eight 3-bit values repacked with +3 bias.
fields.evidence: FUN_0802897c reads block base+9 and extracts 3-bit groups via FUN_0802845c; FUN_08028494 repacks them with FUN_08028408 over the same block.
fields.name: file1_ratings

fields.description: Career file 1 per-rider stat block (EEPROM blocks 12..14). Three 6-bit values per entry.
fields.evidence: FUN_0802897c reads blocks base+10..base+12 and extracts 6-bit groups via FUN_0802845c into 0x84-stride career RAM; FUN_08028494 repacks them with FUN_08028408.
fields.name: file1_stats

fields.description: Career file 1 tail block (EEPROM block 15, 7 data bytes).
fields.evidence: FUN_0802897c reads block base+13 (7 bytes) into career RAM; FUN_08028494 writes the same 7 bytes back via FUN_0802fe9c.
fields.name: file1_tail

fields.description: Career file 1 score table A (EEPROM blocks 16..22, 7 word pairs).
fields.evidence: FUN_0802897c reads blocks base+14..base+20 as word pairs into score RAM; FUN_08028494 writes the same blocks back.
fields.name: file1_scores_a

fields.description: Career file 1 score table B (EEPROM blocks 23..29, 7 words).
fields.evidence: FUN_0802897c reads blocks base+21..base+27 as single words into score RAM; FUN_08028494 writes the same blocks back.
fields.name: file1_scores_b

fields.description: Career file 2 rider initials, char 0 (empty in baseline).

fields.description: Career file 2 rider initials, char 1 (empty in baseline).

fields.description: Career file 2 rider initials, char 2 (empty in baseline).

fields.description: Career file 2 score table A (EEPROM blocks 47..53).
